messages.content: Create a support ticket for customer@test.com with subject 'Login Issue' and priority high

{"to":"customer@test.com","subject":"Login Issue","body":"Dear Customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding the login issue you are experiencing. We understand how important it is for you to access your account without any interruptions.

We are currently prioritizing your ticket as high priority and will investigate the problem promptly. One of our support agents will get back to you as soon as possible with an update.

In the meantime, if you have any additional details or screenshots that might help us understand the issue better, please feel free to reply to this email.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Best regards,
Grace
Support Engineer
VibeTeam"}
